text:
maria: Anyone with EU model-health dash access? I opened the model-health tile for eu-west and got a 403. Need the correct shortlink and who to ping for perms.
kevin: Try the obs shortlink first, e.g. /d/model-health — can you paste the 403 message? sometimes it's the new RBAC mapping.
maria: 403 message says 'Access denied — dashboard.read'. Tried the grafana API quickly: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://grafana.internal/api/dashboards/uid/abcd` => 403. No special errors in console.
samir: pinging @liz and @dashbot to confirm RBAC group mapping — @liz did we change EU team role mapping in the last deploy?
liz: we did a small RBAC clean-up last night. EU team role got moved to `eu-obsv-read` group; we tried to backfill but a handful of users weren't picked up. @maria can you share your org email so I can check?
maria: maria@redwood.com — thanks. Also while I'm here, can someone drop shortlinks for service-overview + model latency tiles for eu? need p95 numbers for gen inference.
dashbot: auto: shortlinks: Service overview (EU): https://grafana.internal/d/svc-overview/eu-services?orgId=1 | Model health (EU): https://grafana.internal/d/model-health/eu-model-tiles?orgId=1. If you still see 403 run: `authctl grant eu-obsv-read maria@redwood.com` (requires approver) or open a ticket in #eng-platform.
kevin: :thumbsup: FYI alert tuning note — model p95 alerts live in the runbook: https://runbooks.internal/alerts/model-regen-p95. Current threshold is 500ms for candidates model; that might be noisy on smaller instance sizes.
maria: thanks. Liz — can you add me to eu-obsv-read? Also filing a quick follow-up: can we consider raising the p95 threshold to 700ms for the candidates model? cc @kevin for review.
liz: added maria@redwood.com to eu-obsv-read, should propagate in a minute. Can you check access now?
maria: opening the links... success, can see model tiles and service overview now :tada:. Bookmarked both. I'll open a PR for the alert threshold change and ping for a quick review.
samir: closing the loop — I also added maria as a watcher on the service dashboard so she gets panel updates. If anyone else hits a 403 in EU, ping me or @liz and we'll check group mappings.
kevin: thanks all. quick note for runbook owners: if we change RBAC groups again, let's add a short migration script to backfill AD members to avoid these lost users.
maria: good call. thanks everyone for the quick help!
